# rustfs_bucket_durability (Resource)

Manage the per-bucket durability override in rustfs.

RustFS allows a bucket to override the process-wide durability mode with its
own `strict`, `relaxed` or `none` tier. When the override is removed the bucket
inherits the process-wide durability mode again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rustfs_bucket" "example" {
  name = "my-bucket"
}

resource "rustfs_bucket_durability" "example" {
  bucket = rustfs_bucket.example.name
  mode   = "strict"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Name of the bucket. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `mode` (String) Durability override for the bucket: `strict`, `relaxed` or `none`. When unset the bucket inherits the process-wide durability mode.

## Import

Import is supported using the bucket name:

```
terraform import rustfs_bucket_durability.example my-bucket
```
